steps.label: fk-base
statements: CREATE TABLE FkParent (Id INT64 NOT NULL) PRIMARY KEY (Id)
CREATE TABLE FkAlterChild (Id INT64 NOT NULL, ParentId INT64, Payload STRING(MAX)) PRIMARY KEY (Id)
CREATE TABLE FkCascadeChild (Id INT64 NOT NULL, ParentId INT64, CONSTRAINT FkCascade FOREIGN KEY (ParentId) REFERENCES FkParent(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE) PRIMARY KEY (Id)
CREATE TABLE FkNoActionChild (Id INT64 NOT NULL, ParentId INT64, CONSTRAINT FkNoAction FOREIGN KEY (ParentId) REFERENCES FkParent(Id) ON DELETE NO ACTION) PRIMARY KEY (Id)

steps.label: fk-inline-set-null

steps.label: fk-alter-set-null
steps.sql: ALTER TABLE FkAlterChild ADD CONSTRAINT FkAlter FOREIGN KEY (ParentId) REFERENCES FkParent(Id) ON DELETE SET NULL

steps.label: fk-reject-not-null
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE FkBadnotnull (Id INT64 NOT NULL, ParentId INT64 NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT FkBad FOREIGN KEY (ParentId) REFERENCES FkParent(Id) ON DELETE SET NULL) PRIMARY KEY (Id)

steps.label: fk-reject-primary-key
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE FkBadprimarykey (Id INT64 NOT NULL, ParentId INT64, CONSTRAINT FkBad FOREIGN KEY (ParentId) REFERENCES FkParent(Id) ON DELETE SET NULL) PRIMARY KEY (Id,ParentId)

steps.label: fk-generated-control
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE FkGenerated (Id INT64 NOT NULL, SourceId INT64, ParentId INT64 AS (SourceId) STORED) PRIMARY KEY (Id)

steps.label: fk-reject-generated
steps.sql: ALTER TABLE FkGenerated ADD CONSTRAINT FkGeneratedReference FOREIGN KEY (ParentId) REFERENCES FkParent(Id) ON DELETE SET NULL

steps.label: fk-reject-not-enforced
